items.title: Deadline to consent to the rent increase (§ 558b BGB)
items.quote: Diesen Brief hat mein Sohn am 18. November 2026 um 10:30 Uhr bei Ihnen eingeworfen.
items.computation: The letter was hand-delivered (not posted by an authority, so no deemed-delivery rule applies) on Wed 18 Nov 2026, as stated by the sender. Under § 558b Abs. 2 BGB the tenant must consent to a rent increase under § 558 by the end of the second calendar month following receipt of the request. Counting from receipt in November 2026: first calendar month after = December 2026, second = January 2027, so the statutory deadline is the end of January 2027, i.e. 31 Jan 2027. That day is a Sunday, so under § 193 BGB the deadline shifts to the next business day, Monday 1 Feb 2027. (Confirmed by the compute_deadline tool.)

items.title: Return the signed consent declaration (Zustimmungserklärung)
items.quote: Bitte senden Sie mir die beigefügte Zustimmungserklärung unterschrieben zurück.
items.computation: The landlord asks for the signed consent form to be returned; to be legally effective this must reach the landlord within the same statutory consent period as above, i.e. by the end of the second calendar month after receipt (31 Jan 2027), shifted under § 193 BGB because that date is a Sunday to the next business day, Monday 1 Feb 2027.

items.title: New rent takes effect, if the tenant agrees
items.quote: Ich bitte Sie, der Erhöhung Ihrer Nettokaltmiete von 480,00 € auf 545,00 € (7,90 € je m² bei 69 m²) ab dem 01.02.2027 zuzustimmen.
items.computation: The landlord requests the increase to apply from 01.02.2027, i.e. the month following expiry of the statutory consent period (end of the second calendar month after the November 2026 receipt = end of January 2027). This matches the earliest date at which an increase under § 558 can take effect once consent is given, so the date as printed stands.

warnings: This is a private rent-increase request (§ 558 BGB) from the landlord, not an authority's decision, so there is no legal-remedy instruction (Rechtsbehelfsbelehrung) and no statutory deemed-delivery rule for posted mail; the stated hand-delivery date and time (18 Nov 2026, 10:30) is the landlord's own account and cannot be independently verified from the letter alone.

The letter does not itself state the legal deadline for the tenant's consent (§ 558b Abs. 2 BGB) or mention that the tenant may refuse or that a court claim would follow non-consent; the computed deadline (1 Feb 2027) is based on statute, not on text in the letter.
